title: Principal registry is pluggable behind a fixed lookup contract
description: The blueprint owns a narrow principal-registry interface with a single isRegistered(email) method returning a Promise resolving to a boolean. The project supplies the registry implementation: a single-address constant for solo-operator deployments, a static allow-list file for small teams, or a database lookup for multi-tenant projects. The magic-link routes call only the registry interface and receive nothing from it except the boolean; principal roles, quotas, and identity metadata are project concerns that layer above this contract, not inside it.
rationale: The security-auth-magic-link blueprint's opinion is on the flow, not on who counts as a principal. Fixing the registry answer in the blueprint would fight every project that scales past its assumed shape; narrowing the contract to a boolean keeps the flow generic while letting the project own the truth.
